risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector where new supply affects the ability to maintain rates and occupancy levels. The addition of competitive hotel rooms may exert downward pressure on pricing and RevPAR margins.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party managers
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on the performance of third-party hotel management companies that operate its properties. Poor service delivery could have a material negative impact on results.

risks.title: High fixed costs
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant fixed costs (staff, leases, taxes, insurance, utilities, marketing). A decline in demand without proportional cost reduction may significantly reduce net revenues and margins.

risks.title: Seasonality
risks.score_rationale: The hotel industry is seasonal, causing fluctuations in occupancy revenues, rates, and operating cash flows depending on location and property type.

risks.title: Real estate asset depreciation
risks.score_rationale: The company must regularly assess the value of its 30 hotel properties (8,868 rooms). A significant decline in asset value may result in material impairment losses.

risks.title: Macroeconomic risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to economic fluctuations and changes in economic conditions that affect travel and hotel stay demand, directly impacting revenues.

ai_positioning.summary: XHR has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its filed documents. Its business focuses on real estate investment in luxury and upper upscale hotels.
